blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala gets another crack at Czech Tereza Valentova in the round of 16 of the WTA 250 Hong Kong Open. Eala is 0-2 against Valentova, who swept the Filipino rising star in their first two meetings, including a 7-6(6), 6-1 victory in February at the Qatar Open round of 64. Their third encounter is tentatively scheduled for Thursday at 2:00 p.m. The second-seeded Eala overcame a tough opening match on Tuesday night, fending off Australian lucky loser Emerson Jones, 6-4, 6-3, at Center Court.
